units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII</cite>, beg. <he>טִיפְטְפָה דם</he> issued drops of blood. Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ top <he>הגשמים מְטַפְטְפִין ויורדין</he> the rain dripped into it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 44a:4">Sabb. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>שמן המְטַפְטֵף</he> oil dripping from the lamp.

senses.gloss: to glisten. Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ sq. החמה מְטַפְטֶפֶת וכ׳ the sun glistens on the tops of the mountains.
